shell.badge_title: Observation views have no mutating route. Settings change configuration only. Closing the workbench changes nothing in any run.
shell.language_note: Changes the interface language only. Nicknames, ids, model names, configuration keys and CLI output stay as recorded.
shell.foot: Zero-gate: observation views only read files that runs already write; no run can observe whether they are open. Settings edit configuration, which the execution layer reads when it resolves a turn.
view.sessions.sub: Every session carries a nickname that is unique among live sessions. The nickname appears in the tmux session name, the run log path, the workbench URL and audit entries.
view.registry.sub: Installed binaries found by the local scan (path lookup, version flag and help text only; no model call), and the variants built on them. A variant is the same binary with a settings file and environment overrides; settings files are referenced by path and never read into the workbench.
view.registry.variants_note: stable ids · no secrets in configuration
view.catalog.sub: Two layers: observations recorded by probes with their provenance, and a curated overlay from configuration. Status is the curated status and decides routability. Flags (unconfirmed, stale, version_drift, effort_mismatch) are warnings that never block routing: unconfirmed means curated but never observed on this host. Rows follow the saved configuration; observations and flags are sample data.
view.routing.sub: Each stage lists its allowed candidates in priority order. The router walks the list, skips candidates that cannot serve right now, and records why. Struck-through candidates are unavailable at the moment.
view.concurrency.sub: A turn needs one slot in each scope that applies: global, its account, its variant when the variant has a cap, and its stage. Slots are leases renewed by the run supervisor; a lease whose holder cannot be confirmed stays counted until it is reconciled. Caps shown are the saved configuration.
view.incidents.sub: Derived from run events, run state and limiter state. The same rules are available to coordinators on the command line; nothing here blocks execution.
settings.note.body: Settings edit platform configuration (cli-platform.toml) only. They never start, stop, pause or gate a run: the execution layer reads the configuration when it resolves a turn, and a running turn keeps the values it was resolved with. Observation views are read-only.
settings.note.layers: Execution layer: Run API, router, limiter, nickname allocator, supervisor; configuration is its input. Event layer: append-only run event logs, limiter journal, catalog observations, published state snapshots; never edited here. Observation layer: the workbench views, read-only.
settings.bar.not_saved: Not saved yet · seeded demo data
settings.page.variants.sub: A variant is a named way to launch an installed binary: adapter, binary, account, an optional settings file (by path) and non-secret environment overrides. Its id is permanent because run records, events and audit entries store it.
settings.page.models.sub: The curated overlay of the model catalog ([[models]]). A model belongs to one variant. Observations recorded by probes stay in the event layer and are not edited here.
settings.page.routing.sub: Each stage lists its allowed candidates in priority order. The router walks the list once per turn; the first serviceable candidate wins. Stage caps are on the Concurrency page.
settings.page.concurrency.sub: Caps, queue bounds and lease timing used by the limiter.
settings.page.nicknames.sub: The nickname library is generated and validated; it is not editable here. Reuse cooldown and the tmux prefix are configuration.
settings.page.general.sub: State directory, catalog freshness and rate-limit cooldown.
settings.variants.empty: No variants. Add one to start.
settings.variants.foot_saved: Saved variant · changes apply to turns resolved after Save
settings.models.empty: No models. Add one to start.
settings.models.foot_saved: Saved model · observations for it stay in the event layer
settings.models.foot_new: New model · not saved yet · flagged unconfirmed until observed
settings.routing.empty: No candidates. This list may be empty.
settings.routing.default_hint: Tried after a stage's own list when none of its candidates can serve. May be empty.
settings.routing.help.on_busy: queue waits for the preferred account; next tries the following candidate when only that account is busy.
settings.routing.help.effort_fallback: lower picks the highest supported level below the requested one; skip moves to the next candidate.
settings.routing.help.allow_pins_outside: when off, a pin outside the stage's list is refused with PIN_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_STAGE. A blank effort means the model's default effort.
settings.concurrency.callout: A turn needs one free slot in every scope that applies: global, its account, its variant if that variant is capped, and its stage. Caps take effect for new leases; running turns are never stopped. Lowering a cap below what is held only delays new grants.
settings.concurrency.variants_note: optional · blank = no variant cap; the account cap still applies
settings.nicknames.library_note: read-only · generated and validated, not edited here

settings.modal.unsaved_blocked.one: Save is unavailable while {count} validation error remains. Discard the changes, or stay and fix them.
settings.modal.unsaved_blocked.other: Save is unavailable while {count} validation errors remain. Discard the changes, or stay and fix them.

settings.modal.unsaved_choice: Save them, discard them, or stay on this page.
settings.modal.reset_body: This replaces the saved configuration in this browser with the seeded sample and discards unsaved changes.
settings.modal.reset_note: Mockup only: in the platform, configuration is a file under version control.
settings.modal.preview_note: Read-only preview. Secret-shaped values are never shown; a draft with SECRET_IN_CONFIG errors cannot be saved.

settings.modal.blocked_body.one: Deleting it would leave stage {stages} with no candidate. Every stage needs at least one.
settings.modal.blocked_body.other: Deleting it would leave stages {stages} with no candidate. Every stage needs at least one.

settings.modal.blocked_variant_hint: Add another candidate to the stage on Stage routing first, or disable the variant instead.
settings.modal.blocked_model_hint: Add another candidate to the stage first, or set the model's status to disabled.
settings.modal.remove_variant_body: This removes the variant from the draft. Nothing changes until you save.
settings.modal.remove_model_body: This removes the model from the curated overlay in the draft. Nothing changes until you save.
settings.modal.rows_removed: These candidate rows will be removed:
settings.modal.keep_records: Run records that name {name} keep it. Ids are permanent, so do not reuse this id for something else; to stop routing to it, disabling is enough.
settings.modal.observations_stay: Observations recorded for it stay in the event layer. Without a curated entry it becomes observed-only (unreviewed).
settings.toast.saved: Configuration saved. New turns resolve with it; running turns keep the values they were resolved with.
settings.toast.saved_local: Saved for this page only: browser storage is unavailable, so a reload shows the previous configuration.
error.SECRET_IN_CONFIG: The configuration contains a value that looks like a credential.
error.NICKNAME_LIBRARY_INVALID: The nickname library is missing or invalid.
error.NICKNAME_NOT_HELD: This nickname is not held by the session.
error.VARIANT_UNKNOWN: No variant with this id is configured.
error.SETTINGS_FILE_UNSAFE: The variant's settings file failed its safety check.
error.STAGE_UNKNOWN: No stage with this id exists.
error.PIN_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_STAGE: The pinned model is not allowed for this stage.
error.PIN_UNSATISFIABLE: The pinned model cannot run now.
error.NO_ROUTE: No candidate can serve this stage.
error.QUEUE_TIMEOUT: The turn waited too long in the queue.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: The CLI needs to sign in again.
error.ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE: The CLI could not be started.
reason.SETTINGS_FILE_NOT_REGULAR: settings file is not a regular file
reason.SETTINGS_FILE_FOREIGN_OWNER: settings file owned by another user
